collar_exact_header_fragment:
(∃ j : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ x δ : ℕ → ℝ, ∃ K A B lam P : ℝ,
        0 < K ∧ 0 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 < P ∧
        (∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m) ∧
          0 < δ m ∧ C.left m < x m - δ m ∧ x m + δ m < C.right m ∧
          (δ m)⁻¹ ≤ K * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ A ∧
          ∀ r ∈ Icc (x m - δ m) (x m + δ m),
            radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ (-B) / (2 * (D.b - D.a)) ≤ opticalSpeed D.w r) ∧
        (∀ m, χ m = returnOpticalCutoff (x m) (δ m / 2)) ∧
        (∀ m, tsupport (deriv (χ m)) ⊆ Icc (x m - δ m / 2) (x m + δ m / 2)) ∧
        (∀ m, tsupport (deriv (χ m)) ⊆ Ioo (x m - δ m) (x m + δ m)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ Kₙ : ℝ, 0 < Kₙ ∧ ∀ m r,
          |iteratedDeriv n (χ m) r| ≤ Kₙ * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ (A * n)) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base' ε', ∀ m p,
          p.1 ∈ Icc (x m - δ m) (x m + δ m) →
          let d := lam * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ (-P) / 2
          0 < d ∧ d ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p ∧
          d ≤ -(originalCoefficients D S C z).c p ∧
          d ^ 2 ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
            (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p * (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p ∧
          0 < (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
            (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p * (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p) ∧
sector_flow_exact_header_fragment:
∀ z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base' ε' ε',
        ∀ m r, r ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) → ∀ θ,
          1 / 2 ≤ deriv (C.minusFlow (liftSectorParameter S C z) m r) θ ∧
          deriv (C.minusFlow (liftSectorParameter S C z) m r) θ ≤ 3 / 2
mapping: j is the same full negative-component host map exported as cell; it is chosen in hcollar, not reset to the atlas half-cell.
x,delta and the same cutoff chi are from the original hcollar. chi equals returnOpticalCutoff(x)(delta/2), with derivative support in the half buffer and strictly inside the full buffer.
K,A control delta inverse and the actual all-order chi jets. B is the optical-speed exponent; lam,P give original coefficient a and discriminant lower bounds on the same closed physical buffer.
All collar constants precede component/state/order variables except the permitted derivative-specific K_n. No estimate of final coordinates is assumed.
The sector flow slope lower/upper hflow is the final actual provider output already obtained in the current148 construction; returning it changes no base,epsilon or witness.
consumer_projections: For central transport use l=x-delta, h=x+delta and hstripSupport; hdata supplies C.left<l<h<C.right together with positive delta.
For coefficient reciprocal/spatial growth use hpositive.2.1 : d<=a and hpositive.2.2.2.1 : d^2<=discriminant, where d=lam*radialE(index(j m))^(-P)/2.
For selector uniform actual inverse/circle operations use hflow directly on sectorNeighborhood S basePrime epsilonPrime epsilonPrime.
For all-state original discriminant on cutoff support retain the existing hdiscFull separately; it is stronger in domain than merely sector states.
